notes.note: Multi-select screens: Launchpad's multi-select screens are different from the Academy's multiple choice template. Academy multiple choice grades against a correct-answer key, while Launchpad's version is pure capture: any combination of taps is valid, with no right or wrong. Plan: reuse the Academy multiple choice design template but tweak the logic to multi-select. Melvin will build it; no action needed yet.

Task screens: each bronze task has Context, Guidance, Question and Data Input. A task may span one or multiple screens. If context, guidance, question and interaction fit on one screen, use one; otherwise split context and guidance onto screen one and the interaction onto screen two. That split may be the better default for every task.

Two-bucket rule: wrap-ups and bronzes have a service and a make-and-sell payload version (make-and-sell covers craft and digital products). The business picked on the Launchpad home screen sets the flag, so there is no new decision tree. The Payload version column marks each row Shared, Service, Make-and-sell, or Shared with skin-specific examples. See Build Specs section 8.

Templates: screen template cells use the agreed shared template set (Jasper list, Cath approved 4 Nov). Reuse: multiple-choice, bucket-sort, tap-reveal, true-false, completion. Tweak: multiple-choice capture, rank-order, word-drop, budget-select, allocation slider, savings-goal meter. New: workbook template screen (wrap-ups), money calculator, short text box. Illustrations are optional per screen; mark no-picture screens explicitly.

Wrap-up (silver summary) screens: Context, Guidance and Question are N/A. The wrap-up shows the workbook page filled in with the silver's answers, and the clearly marked edit icons tell the learner they can change things there (Cath, 4 Nov).
